script: Jupiter is more than twice as massive as all the other planets combined. More than 1,300 Earths could fit inside it. It is made mostly of hydrogen and helium, like a star. But it would need to be about 80 times heavier to start shining like one. In 1994, scientists watched a comet smash into it. Follow WonderBytes for more facts that sound fake but are true.
